    local args = {
    [1] = "Knife",
    [2] = KILL_ALL.Name,
    [3] = {

        [3] = Vector3.new(0.10178784281015396, -0.027272216975688934, 0.22670568525791168),

    }
}

workspace:WaitForChild("GameMain"):WaitForChild("Triggers"):WaitForChild("ServerRequest"):WaitForChild("Damage"):FireServer(unpack(args))
end
